SELECT status, fulfilment_type, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS n_orders,
 SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS helsinki_day,
 MIN(order_ts_utc) mn, MAX(order_ts_utc) mx
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' AND status <> 'cancelled'
), t AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.receipt_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE p.category = 'ZZ Test' AND f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM o)
), l AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, COUNT(*) n, MIN(store_key) mnk, COUNT(DISTINCT store_key) sk FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM o) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o) AS orders,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM o) AS distinct_orders,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t) AS test_orders,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE web_order_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM l)) AS no_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id WHERE l.n <> o.line_count) AS linecount_mismatch,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o WHERE login_state='guest') AS guests,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_ids_all,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stg_web_order_load WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28') AS stg_rows

calls.statement:
SELECT CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) AS utc_day,
 COUNT(*) AS all_orders,
 SUM(CASE WHEN status<>'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_cancelled,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status<>'cancelled' THEN (member_key, order_ts_utc, order_total_gross, line_count) END) AS distinct_sig
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
